note: General Mathematics major (MA29). UCSD offers 7 BS math majors; this file covers the general Mathematics major only, not Applied Mathematics, Math-CS, Math-Econ, Math-Applied Science, Probability and Statistics, or Mathematical Biology.

requirements.name: Lower-division: one calculus/linear algebra sequence
requirements.note: One of: MATH 18 + MATH 20A-B-C-D-E (Linear Algebra and Calculus), or MATH 31AH-BH-CH + MATH 20D (Honors Calculus). MATH 20D and 20E need not be taken in order; majors advised to take MATH 18 as early as possible.

requirements.name: Mathematical Reasoning
requirements.note: Students completing MATH 31AH-BH-CH may substitute a four-unit upper-division mathematics elective for MATH 109

requirements.name: Analysis sequence (one of)
requirements.note: One of: MATH 140A-B Foundations of Real Analysis, or MATH 142A-B + MATH 120A Introduction to Analysis. MATH 140A-B-C recommended for graduate school.

requirements.name: Algebra sequence (one of)
requirements.note: One of: MATH 100A-B Abstract Algebra, or MATH 103A-B + MATH 102 Modern Applied Algebra. MATH 100A-B-C recommended for graduate school.

requirements.name: Upper-division electives to reach 13 courses (52 units)
requirements.note: Thirteen four-unit upper-division courses (52 units) total required. Electives chosen from any MATH 100–194 (MATH 195/196/197/198/199/199H cannot count). Typical elective count is 6–8 depending on sequence choices; encoded as 8 (maximum) — app should compute remaining from completed required courses. Grade of C- or better required in all major courses; 2.0 GPA minimum in upper-division major courses.
